hook.text: One percent of Twitter users produce 80% of all tweets. A tiny minority dominates the conversation.

buildup.text: In epidemiology, super-spreaders infect far more than average. Social networks have them too.

discovery.text: Super-spreaders aren't always famous. Some are just hyper-connected individuals at network crossroads.

twist.text: Targeting super-spreaders is more effective than mass campaigns. One right person beats a million wrong ones.

climax.text: Disinformation campaigns exploit this. Infect a super-spreader with a lie and the network carries it.

punchline.text: One node can move an entire network.

quiz.question: What makes someone a social media super-spreader?
